# Legal Agreements

## Overview
This wiki page outlines terms, conditions, and excerpts related to official project compliance and participant contracts, focusing specifically on [Beta Testing](./beta-testing.md) agreements for [Hardware](./hardware.md) and software implementations such as the [Aurora Nova Widget](./aurora-nova-widget.md).

## Key Details
Based on beta tester agreement [Documentation](./documentation.md), key operational and legal constraints include:

* **[Confidentiality](./confidentiality.md) (Section 4):** Beta [Firmware](./firmware.md), MeshSync source partials, and [Power Budget](./power-budget.md) spreadsheets are strictly confidential.
* **Safety & Hardware Ratings (Section 7):** The device is rated IP54 splash-resistant only and must not be submerged. Outdoor burial (similar to [SenseNode SN-400](./sensenode-sn-400.md)-style deployments) is explicitly not supported.
* **Data Policy (Section 9):** Telemetry data remains local by default, with optional [MQTT Export](./mqtt-export.md) available only via user configuration.
* **Endorsement Restrictions (Section 12):** Beta testers are permitted to mention products like [TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md), but doing so carries no implied Aurora partnership.

## Related Entities
* **Aurora Nova Widget:** The primary hardware/software subject of the beta tester agreement.
* **MeshSync:** Software component whose source partial is covered under confidentiality terms.
* **TeaBuddy:** External product that beta testers are allowed to mention under endorsement guidelines.

## Related Concepts
* **Beta Testing:** The controlled evaluation phase governed by confidentiality, telemetry, and safety clauses.
* **[Hardware Safety](./hardware-safety.md):** Compliance standards addressing environmental limits, such as the IP54 splash-resistant rating.
* **Telemetry Data:** User data handling [Protocols](./protocols.md) emphasizing local storage and optional user-configured MQTT exports.
